traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Drive meets imagination. Energy steered by vision and a persuasive, magnetic pull. The trine makes this a natural strength: Charismatic motivation; action aligned with imagination. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Drive and imagination flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what drive and imagination have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Inspiring and persuasive; keep the aim concrete or the drive dissipates.
shadow: The ease lets anger and recklessness and illusion and escapism go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.

readerCopy.body: You do not have to explain exactly why something matters to you before you are allowed to act like it matters. When Mars trines Neptune, action can follow compassion, intuition, creativity, or conviction without requiring you to turn every feeling into an argument first. Sometimes the quickest way through a feeling is to give it something to do. Make the thing, help the person, follow the instinct, and let the action show you what all that thinking could not. You do not need to know where the feeling is leading before you let it move you.
